claims.disproof_condition: 條件：下一份定期報告或說明資料寫出 PCB 化學品（沉銅、電鍍添加劑）營收轉為年減、或伺服器／資料中心相關需求轉弱；或板廠（客戶端）一手寫出改用別家化學品或自行替代。核查頻率：每季（定期報告、決算說明資料）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀電鍍化學品層讀圖的需求段與供給段。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Element Solutions FY2025 10-K): Circuitry Solutions, about 29% of Electronics segment 2025 net sales, grew 12% reported and 10% organically, primarily because continued AI and data-centre investment drove demand for metallization solutions; its most significant electronics competitors are MKS Instruments, Qnity Electronics, Henkel, Senju Metal and Uyemura. Self-reported.

source_doc.title: Element Solutions（ESI）2025 年度 10-K：電子部門的 Circuitry Solutions（約占部門 2025 營收 29%）做 PCB 濕製程化學品；通孔金屬化產品；2025 年 Circuitry Solutions 有機成長 10%，主因 AI 與資料中心投資帶動金屬化解決方案需求；具名競爭者 MKS、Qnity、Henkel、千住、上村

sources.quote: Our Electronics segment researches, formulates and sells specialty chemicals and material process technologies for all types of electronics hardware, from complex printed circuit board designs to advanced semiconductor packaging.
Circuitry Solutions - representing approximately 29% of the segment's 2025 net sales.
Circuit board metallization products are used to plate holes drilled through printed circuit boards to connect opposite sides of the board and multi-layered printed circuit boards.
The increase in organic net sales was primarily due to continued AI and data center investment driving demand for metallization solutions.
our most significant competitors are MKS Instruments, Qnity Electronics, Inc., Henkel Corporation, Senju Metal Industry Co. and Uyemura International.
Element Solutions' MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions business segment.
